title: Physical Features of Geometrically Deformed Anisotropic Charged Three-dimensional BTZ Black Holes
summary: This work employs the minimal geometric deformation decoupling scheme to derive interior stellar solutions in the background of an electrically charged BTZ ansatz as a seed metric in three dimensions. In this respect, we impose two different equations of state to determine the deformation function and the new material contributions emerging from the additional field source.
